site.name: IMAP connector
nav.label: Main menu
footer.local: This page works only on this computer.
footer.idle: The IMAP connector settings close automatically after {minutes} minutes without activity.
footer.idle_one: The IMAP connector settings close automatically after one minute without activity.
footer.idle_off: The IMAP connector settings do not close automatically. Close them when you are done.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lead: These are the e-mail accounts the AI tool may use, and what it may do with each of them.
accounts.caption: Configured accounts
accounts.col.name: Name
accounts.empty_text: Add an account so that the AI tool can read your e-mail.
accounts.config_path: The settings are stored in the file {path}. The file never contains any passwords.
perm.read_marking.user_open: Marks as read when you open a message
keyring.missing_title: There is no secure keychain on this computer
keyring.missing_text: Passwords therefore cannot be stored from this page. Put the password in the environment variable {var} instead, where {placeholder} is the account's short name in capital letters. You can also point to a file that contains the password with {var_file}.
form.lead: Fill in the details from your e-mail provider. You can usually find them in the provider's help pages about IMAP.
form.optional_note: Fields marked (optional) can be left empty. All other fields must be filled in.
form.save_failed: The account could not be saved: {detail}
form.idle_note: For security, the settings close after {minutes} minutes without activity. Anything you have typed but not saved is then lost. You get a warning first, so that you have time to continue.
form.idle_note_one: For security, the settings close after one minute without activity. Anything you have typed but not saved is then lost.
hint.display_name: A name you recognise, for example Work or Personal.
hint.account_id_new: The account gets a short name, made from the account name when you save. The short name is used in the AI tool to tell the accounts apart.
hint.account_id_edit: The short name is used in the AI tool to tell the accounts apart. It cannot be changed.
hint.imap_port: Usually 993 for SSL/TLS and 143 for STARTTLS.
hint.username: Usually your e-mail address. Leave empty if it is the same as the e-mail address.
hint.password_new: The password is stored in the computer's keychain, never in the settings file.
hint.password_keep: A password is already stored. Leave the field empty to keep the current password.
hint.password_none: No password is stored for this account yet.
hint.password_provider: Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com no longer accept passwords for IMAP. They require signing in with OAuth, which is not supported yet. Gmail, iCloud and Fastmail require an app password, which you create in the account's security settings.
hint.password_again: For security, a password you typed is not kept when the form has errors. Type it again.
smtp.intro: Only needed if the AI tool may send mail directly. Drafts are saved over IMAP.
hint.smtp_port: Usually 465 for SSL/TLS and 587 for STARTTLS.
hint.smtp_username: Leave empty to use the same user name as for IMAP.
hint.smtp_password: Leave empty to use the same password as for IMAP.
hint.smtp_password_keep: A separate SMTP password is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
folders.intro: Leave the fields empty to find the folders automatically. Only fill them in if the wrong folder is found.
hint.folder: The folder name on the server, for example Sent Items.
save_sent.auto_hint: Saves a copy in the Sent folder, except when the server does it itself, as Gmail does.
save_sent.always_hint: Always saves a copy in the Sent folder.
save_sent.never_hint: Saves no copy. Choose this if the server always saves sent mail itself.
fs.read_marking: When should mail be marked as read?
read_marking.never: Never – nothing is marked as read by this connector (recommended)
read_marking.never_hint: What the AI tool reads is never marked as read, and neither is what you open yourself.
read_marking.user_open: When I open a message myself in the side panel
read_marking.user_open_hint: Applies only when you read in the mailbox panel in Claude. What the AI tool reads is still never marked as read.
fs.permissions: What may the AI tool do?
permissions.intro: The AI tool can always read the mail in the account. Here you choose what else it may do.
field.organise: Organise: flag, mark as read or unread, move, copy and put in the trash
send_mode.drafts: Save drafts only – you send them yourself
send_mode.warning: Text in an e-mail you have received can try to make the AI tool send mail. If the tool may both read and send, it can be tricked into sending mail you did not ask for. Saving drafts only is therefore the safer choice.
errors.summary_one: There is one problem to fix
errors.summary_intro: Fix the following and save again:
error.display_name: Enter a name for the account, for example Work.
error.email: Enter an e-mail address with an @, for example name@example.com.
error.imap_host: Enter the address of the IMAP server, for example imap.example.com.
error.imap_port: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535, for example 993.
error.imap_security: Choose SSL/TLS or STARTTLS for incoming mail.
error.smtp_host: Enter the address of the SMTP server, for example smtp.example.com. It is needed when the AI tool may send mail directly.
error.smtp_port: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535, for example 465.
error.smtp_security: Choose SSL/TLS or STARTTLS for outgoing mail.
error.save_sent: Choose when a copy of sent mail should be saved.
error.send_mode: Choose what the AI tool may do when writing mail.
error.read_marking: Choose when mail should be marked as read.
error.password: Enter the password for the account.
error.password_keychain: The password could not be stored because there is no secure keychain. Leave the field empty and put the password in the environment variable {var} instead.
error.smtp_password: The SMTP password could not be stored because there is no secure keychain. Leave the field empty and put the password in the environment variable {var} instead.
error.password_not_stored: The other details are saved, but the password could not be stored in the computer's keychain. Type the password again and save. Until then the account has no password.
error.smtp_password_not_stored: The other details are saved, but the SMTP password could not be stored in the computer's keychain. Type the password again and save.
test.title: Test connection to {name}
test.lead: The test signs in to the IMAP server and reads the list of folders. No mail is read and nothing is changed.
test.fail_text: The server or the computer replied:
test.fail_advice: Check the server, port, user name and password, and try again.
delete.title: Do you want to delete the account {name}?
delete.text: The account and its stored passwords are removed from this computer.
delete.not_server: No mail is deleted from the server. You can add the account again later.
notfound.title: The account does not exist
notfound.text: There is no account with the short name {id}. It may have been deleted.
closed.title: The IMAP connector settings are closed
closed.text: You can close this tab now.
closed.again: To change something later, open the IMAP connector settings again from the AI tool or with the command {cmd}.
forbidden.title: Start the IMAP connector settings again
forbidden.text: This page cannot be shown. The link to the settings works only once, and only while the settings are open.
forbidden.again: Open the IMAP connector settings again from the AI tool or with the command {cmd}.
rejected.title: The form could not be sent
rejected.text: This can happen if the page was opened from another website or if the settings were restarted. Go back to the accounts and try again.
configerror.title: The settings file could not be read
configerror.text: The file {path} could not be read. Correct or move the file and reload the page. The error was:
idle.title: The settings will close soon
idle.text: If nothing happens, the settings close at {time}. Anything you have typed but not saved is then lost. Choose Continue if you need more time.
idle.closed_text: The settings closed because nothing happened for a while. Anything you did not save is still on the page, but it can no longer be saved. Open the settings again from the AI tool.
leave.title: What you have typed is not saved
leave.text: If you leave the form now, what you have typed is lost. Do you want to stay and save first?
dialog.title: IMAP connector
dialog.confirm.intro: Do you want to save the changes to the account {name}? These changes give the AI tool more permissions or send the stored password to a different server:
dialog.reason.new_with_permissions: The new account gets permissions beyond reading mail.
dialog.reason.organise_on: The AI tool may organise mail: flag, mark as read or unread, move and put in the trash.
dialog.reason.send_raised: The AI tool may write more kinds of mail than before (drafts or sending directly).
dialog.reason.server_changed: The server details change. The stored password will be sent to the new server at the next login.
dialog.password.imap:
Enter the password for {user} on {host} (account {name}).

The password is stored in the keychain on this computer and is not sent through the AI tool.
dialog.password.smtp:
Enter the password for sending mail as {user} via {host} (account {name}).

The password is stored in the keychain on this computer and is not sent through the AI tool.
dialog.delete.message:
Do you want to delete the account {name}?

The account and its stored passwords are removed from this computer. No mail on the server is affected.
send_approval.ask_or_window: Ask, but let me allow sending for a while
hint.send_approval: Applies when the AI tool may send directly. A macOS window shows the recipients, subject and text, and nothing is sent until you approve. Without macOS the AI tool asks you instead, and if that is not possible the message is saved as a draft.
hint.send_approval_window: The window gets an extra button that allows sending without asking for {minutes} minutes. The permission also ends when Claude restarts or the account's settings change.
hint.send_approval_never: Messages are sent without asking you. Text in mail you have received can then try to make the AI tool send mail on someone else's behalf.
send.dialog.title: Send mail?
send.dialog.intro: The AI tool wants to send this message from the account {name}:
send.subject: Subject
dialog.reason.approval_relaxed: You will be asked less often before mail is sent.
error.send_approval: Choose when you want to be asked before mail is sent.
settingspanel.title: Mail settings
settingspanel.lead: Here you choose which e-mail accounts the AI tool may use and what it may do with each of them.
settingspanel.connect_failed: The panel could not reach the AI tool. Close the panel and open it again.
settingspanel.load_failed: The settings could not be loaded. The error was:
settingspanel.native.title: Why some things are confirmed in a macOS window
settingspanel.native.text: You never type passwords in this panel, but in a window that macOS shows. You also confirm there any change that gives the AI tool more permissions or sends a stored password to a different server, and when you delete an account. The window is shown by the computer, not by the AI tool, so neither the password nor your approval passes through the AI tool.
settingspanel.browser.title: Passwords and some changes are made in the browser
settingspanel.browser.text: This computer cannot show the windows needed for typing passwords and confirming changes. You therefore set passwords, delete accounts and give the AI tool more permissions on the settings page in the browser. Here you can see the accounts, change names and folders, and lower permissions.
settingspanel.browser.button: Open the settings page in the browser
settingspanel.browser.opening: Opening the settings page in the browser …
settingspanel.browser.opened: The settings page opens in the browser.
settingspanel.browser.needed_title: This change is made in the browser
settingspanel.browser.needed_text: Nothing was saved. The change needs to be confirmed, and this computer cannot show the window for that. Make the change on the settings page in the browser instead.
settingspanel.browser.needed_reasons: The change needs to be confirmed because:
settingspanel.readonly.title: The settings can only be viewed here
settingspanel.readonly.text: The connector does not run on this computer, so the settings cannot be changed from the panel. Change them on the computer where the connector runs.
settingspanel.keyring.title: There is no secure keychain on this computer
settingspanel.keyring.text: Passwords therefore cannot be stored from here. Put the password in the environment variable IMAP_SECRET_<SHORTNAME> instead, where <SHORTNAME> is the account's short name in capital letters.
settingspanel.config_problems.title: The settings file has errors
settingspanel.config_problems.text: This part of the settings file could not be read:
settingspanel.config_file: The settings are stored in the file {path}. The file never contains any passwords.
settingspanel.list.title: Accounts
settingspanel.list.empty_text: Add an account so that the AI tool can read your mail.
settingspanel.perm.read_marking.user_ope: Marks as read when you open a message
settingspanel.busy: Wait until the current task is finished.
settingspanel.failed: That did not work. The error was:
settingspanel.password.waiting: Type the password in the window that macOS shows. The panel waits until you have answered.
settingspanel.password.stored: The password for {name} is stored in the computer's keychain.
settingspanel.password.smtp_stored: The SMTP password for {name} is stored in the computer's keychain.
settingspanel.password.cancelled: No password was stored, because you cancelled in the window.
settingspanel.test.fail_text: The server or the computer answered:
settingspanel.test.fail_advice: Check the server, port, user name and password and try again.
settingspanel.delete.waiting: Confirm the deletion in the window that macOS shows. The panel waits until you have answered.
settingspanel.delete.done_text: The account and its stored passwords are removed from this computer. No mail on the server was affected.
settingspanel.delete.cancelled: The account was not deleted, because you cancelled in the window.
settingspanel.form.lead: Fill in the details from your e-mail provider. You usually find them in the provider's help pages about IMAP.
settingspanel.form.optional_note: Fields marked (optional) can be left empty. All other fields must be filled in.
settingspanel.form.confirm_note: If you give the AI tool more permissions, or change the server details of an account with a stored password, you confirm the change in a macOS window when you save.
settingspanel.form.password_new: You set the password once the account is saved. A macOS window then asks for it, so the password is never typed in the panel.
settingspanel.form.password_stored: A password is stored for the account. You change it with the Set password button in the list of accounts.
settingspanel.form.password_none: No password is stored for the account yet. You set it with the Set password button in the list of accounts.
settingspanel.form.confirm_waiting: Confirm the change in the window that macOS shows. The panel waits until you have answered.
settingspanel.form.cancelled: Nothing was saved, because you cancelled in the window. You can change the details and save again.
settingspanel.form.save_failed: The account could not be saved. The error was:
settingspanel.fs.smtp_intro: Only needed if the AI tool may send mail directly. Drafts are saved via IMAP.
settingspanel.fs.folders_intro: Leave the fields empty to have the folders found automatically. Only fill them in if the wrong folder is found.
settingspanel.fs.save_sent: Save a copy of sent mail
settingspanel.fs.read_marking: When should mail be marked as read?
settingspanel.fs.permissions: What may the AI tool do?
settingspanel.fs.permissions_intro: The AI tool can always read the mail in the account. Here you choose what else it may do.
settingspanel.errors.summary_one: There is one error to correct
settingspanel.errors.summary_intro: Correct the following and save again:
settingspanel.errors.generic: Check the value in the field.
settingspanel.newpw.text: The account has no password yet. When you choose Set password now, macOS opens a window where you type the password. The password is stored in the computer's keychain and is not sent through the AI tool.
settingspanel.newpw.browser: The account has no password yet. Set it on the settings page in the browser.
settingspanel.send_approval.inactive: Applies only when the AI tool may send mail directly.
settingspanel.perm.send_approval.ask: Asks you before each message is sent
settingspanel.perm.send_approval.ask_or_: Asks you before messages are sent, with the option to skip the question for 30 minutes
mailbox.title: Mail
mailbox.connect_failed: The mailbox could not connect to the app. Close the panel and open it again.
mailbox.empty_title: There is no mail account yet
mailbox.empty_text: You add an account in the mail settings. Ask Claude to open them, for example by writing “Open the mail settings”.
mailbox.empty_ask: Ask Claude to open the settings
mailbox.empty_ask_text: Open the mail settings so I can add an account.
mailbox.ask_failed_settings: The request could not be sent to the chat. Write to Claude instead: “Open the mail settings”.
mailbox.search_note: The server cannot search for letters such as å, ä and ö. Sender and subject were therefore searched among the most recent messages, so older matches may be missing.
mailbox.organise_off: Organising mail is turned off for this account. You can turn it on in the settings.
mailbox.list_hint: Use the arrow keys to move between messages and press Enter to open one.
mailbox.list_empty: There are no messages in this folder.
mailbox.read_placeholder: Choose a message in the list to read it.
mailbox.move_choose_first: First choose the folder to move to.
mailbox.ask_text: I have a question about a message in my mail: “{subject}” in account {account}, folder {folder} (uid {uid}, uidvalidity {uidvalidity}). Read the message with imap_get_message.
mailbox.asked: The question is now in the chat.
mailbox.ask_failed: The question could not be sent to the chat. Write to Claude instead and mention the subject of the message.
mailbox.html_note: The message was written in HTML and is shown here as plain text.
mailbox.truncated: The message is long and is not shown in full here.
mailbox.attachments_note: Attachments cannot be opened in the panel.
mailbox.marked_read_on_open: The message is marked as read.
mailbox.done.mark_read.one: The message is marked as read.
mailbox.done.mark_unread.one: The message is marked as unread.
mailbox.done.unflag.other: The flag is removed from {n} messages.
mailbox.done.trash.one: The message is moved to the trash.
mailbox.done.trash.other: {n} messages are moved to the trash.
mailbox.confirm_trash_title.one: Move the message to the trash?
mailbox.confirm_trash_text: You can move messages back out of the trash until it is emptied.
mailbox.error_folders: The folders could not be fetched. {detail}
mailbox.error_list: The messages could not be fetched. {detail}
mailbox.error_open: The message could not be opened. {detail}
mailbox.error_action: The change could not be made. {detail}
mailbox.stale_reloaded: The folder has changed on the server, so the list has been loaded again.
mailbox.stale_retry: The folder has changed on the server. The list has been loaded again, so please try once more.
mailbox.privacy: What you read and do here is not passed to Claude. Claude sees a message only if you press “Ask Claude about this message”.
mailbox.read_rule.never: Messages are not marked as read when you open them here.
mailbox.read_rule.user_open: Messages are marked as read when you open them here.
mailbox.folder_hint: Use the arrow keys to move between folders and press Enter to open one.
mailbox.asked_settings: The request is now in the chat.
send.quoted_from: This is followed by a quotation added by the connector, of the message from {sender}:
dialog.reason.attachments_on: Attachments may be saved on this computer, in the attachments folder.
dialog.choose_attachments_folder: Choose the folder where attachments are saved. Each account gets its own subfolder with year and month.
dialog.choose_knowledge_file: Choose the Markdown file with questions and answers for the account {name}.
dialog.remove_knowledge:
Do you want to remove the knowledge base for the account {name}?

The file is removed from the connector's folder. Your own original file is not affected.
